collections.title: Cell Biology and Genetics — Guided Foundations
collections.summary: Eight finished standalone lectures tracing cells from membranes and genomes through proteins, biochemical signaling, intracellular traffic, and cell-cycle decisions. The track is still in progress.

collections.title: Genetics First — Gene Expression and Inheritance
collections.summary: Begin with how the genome is read, then learn how it is copied, sorted, and inherited. A shorter entry path for listeners already familiar with cells and membranes.
